title: 第256章 圣器神纹醉道人出手第255章 认一个武圣大哥
slug: 大婚之日我阉了未婚妻的白月光
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：大婚之日，我阉了未婚妻的白月光第一卷：默认第256章圣器！神纹！醉道人出手！（..la）两个黄金箭头，一模一样。
同样的金属，同样的箭头。
但给人的气息，完全不一样！
切出来的圣器箭头，带着一股恐怖的杀伐之力！哪怕叶凡握在手中，明知道不会伤害到自己，依旧有一种心惊胆颤的感觉，仿佛握着一颗随时可能爆炸的核弹。
复制品，空有其形，却没有任何圣威。
叶凡问道：“小鼎，怎么回事？”
混沌万物鼎的声音传来：“主人，复制没有神纹的附魔武器！可以复制出一模一样的武器。”
“但圣器不同，圣器内部有神纹，此物不属于能量转换，无法复制。”
叶凡惊愕：“神纹是什么？”
混沌万物鼎解释道：“兵器内部，刻下的纹理！您可以理解为，类似于在兵器内部刻下阵法一样，发挥出更大的威力。”
“神纹是修武者，用精神力篆刻！不属于能量层面，所以无法复制。”
叶凡明白了。
这就好比，叶凡现在用天地熔炉，复制一部手机。
手机的各种电路板、电池、屏幕一模一样，却没办法复制手机内的照片！
天地熔炉可以复制丹药！可以复制玄武神药！也能复制附魔武器！因为能量守恒！
圣器的箭头，也能复制，但内部的神纹不属于能量，所以无法复制！
“靠……我还想着批量生产圣器呢！”
叶凡有些失望。
转念一想。
圣器无法批量生产，才更显得珍贵！

“空有一个圣器箭头，没办法发挥出最大的杀伤力！”
“回头去找唐妙衣，把它变成一支箭！”叶凡想着，刚想去看看叶弑天的情况。
突然，外界传来王大年的声音。
“我家帮主正在休息，现在人等禁止打扰！”
啪——！
一声脆响！
叶凡一下子回到现实，正好看到王大年抽飞出去，‘砰’的一声撞在身后的墙壁上，嘴角更是哇的吐出一口鲜血，夹着两颗牙齿。
“大长老！”
傲天帮众人震怒！
纷纷取出ak47，对准出手之人！出手的青年脸色阴沉，眸子冰冷，看着傲天帮众人，像是看一群死人！
“这是谁啊？”
“这种时候，敢找叶凡的麻烦？”
众人一阵惊愕。
姬沐阳、轩辕逸飞、澹台飞旋，惊讶的看过来。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: On the wedding day, I castrated my fiancée Bai Yueguang Volume 1: Default Chapter 256 Sacred Artifact! Divine pattern! The drunk Taoist takes action! (..la) Two golden arrows, exactly the same.
Same metal, same arrow.
But the aura it gives is completely different!
The cut out sacred arrowhead carries a terrifying killing power! Even though Mark was holding it in his hand, knowing that it would not hurt him, he still had a frightening feeling, as if he was holding a nuclear bomb that might explode at any time.
The copy has its own form, but it has no holy power.
Ye Fan asked: "Xiao Ding, what's going on?"
The voice of the Chaos Cauldron of All Things came: "Master, copy the enchanted weapon without divine patterns! You can copy the exact same weapon."
"But the sacred artifact is different. There are divine patterns inside the sacred artifact. This object does not belong to energy conversion and cannot be copied."
Ye Fan was shocked: "What is the divine pattern?"
The Cauldron of Chaos Everything explained: "The textures carved inside the weapon! You can understand it as similar to the formation carved inside the weapon, which can exert greater power."
"The divine patterns are carved by warriors using their spiritual power! They do not belong to the energy level, so they cannot be copied."
Ye Fan understood.
This is like Ye Fan now using the furnace of heaven and earth to replicate a mobile phone.
The various circuit boards, batteries, and screens of the mobile phone are exactly the same, but there is no way to copy the photos in the mobile phone!
The furnace of heaven and earth can copy elixirs! You can copy the Xuanwu magic medicine! Enchanted weapons can also be copied! Because energy is conserved!
The arrows of the sacred weapon can also be copied, but the divine patterns inside do not belong to energy, so they cannot be copied!
"Damn... I'm still thinking about mass-producing sacred artifacts!"
Ye Fan was a little disappointed.
Then I thought about it.
The sacred artifact cannot be mass-produced, which makes it even more precious!
"There is no way for a sacred weapon arrow to exert its maximum lethality!"
"Go back to Tang Miaoyi and turn it into an arrow!" Ye Fan thought, just about to check on Ye Shitian.
Suddenly, Wang Danian's voice came from the outside world.
"My gang leader is taking a rest, no one is allowed to disturb him now!"
Snap——!
A crisp sound!
Ye Fan suddenly returned to reality, just in time to see Wang Danian flying out, hitting the wall behind him with a bang, and spitting out a mouthful of blood from the corner of his mouth, holding two teeth.
"Great Elder!"
Everyone in Aotian Gang was furious!
They all took out their AK47s and pointed them at the person who made the move! The young man who took action had a gloomy face and cold eyes. He looked at the Aotian Gang as if he were looking at a group of dead people!
"Who is this?"
"At this time, do you dare to cause trouble for Mark?"
Everyone was shocked for a while.
Ji Muyang, Xuanyuan Yifei, and Tantai Feixuan looked over in surprise.
